question: How should the all-pervading Narasimha be visualized across the body?
premises: Narasimha is the object of meditation.
The visualization extends from head to feet.
inference: One should meditate on the all-pervading Narasimha from the head down to the feet.
plain_english: One should meditate on the all-pervading Narasimha from the head down to the feet.
